lines.quote: I designed the digital beamforming architecture for a 32-element receive array operating in X-band, implementing the real-time beamformer in C++ on a Zynq FPGA/ARM SoC.

Developed the extended Kalman filter chain for Aurinko's AV-300 instrument, performing platform motion compensation for SAR imaging. Six-state estimator fused with IMU data at 200 Hz, implemented in C++ on a Xilinx Zynq SoC under hard 5 ms update-rate constraints.

Built and maintained the Python-based calibration and QC pipeline for AV-300 and AV-500 SAR imagery. Ingests raw data products, applies radiometric and geometric corrections, generates calibration reports. Production code: unit-tested, type-annotated, CI via GitLab, maintained by three engineers.
RF measurement and characterisation (Rohde & Schwarz ZVA network analyser, Keysight spectrum analysers, anechoic-chamber antenna pattern verification)
